name: install-docs
body: Install docs: README.md's Install section — front-loaded Homebrew (macOS) and Scoop (Windows) commands for tap/bucket, install and upgrade, followed by manual GitHub Release download as the Linux route and fallback, linking to INSTALL.md (readme-install-front-loading) — INSTALL.md, the detailed plain-language guide per OS, and the docs/ author references linked from README.md (docs/templates.md, docs/layered-libraries.md, docs/cookbook.md — docs-templates, docs-layered-libraries, docs-cookbook). The macOS Homebrew commands are `brew tap really-knows-ai/kalide <url>`, then the tap-level `brew trust really-knows-ai/kalide`, then `brew install kalide`; the trust step is required by Homebrew 6.0.0+ for the custom-remote third-party tap (the per-formula `brew trust --formula` form is refused for it) and is shown in both README.md and INSTALL.md. Both routes are anonymous and open to any user (global.constraint.anonymous-install). The docs distinguish upgrading the kalide binary from bringing a project forward with `kalide upgrade` (install-docs, deck-library-upgrade). README.md is presented as kalide's front page with a brand hero image from `brand/` and links to LICENSE and CHANGELOG.md (readme-presentation). Realised by README.md, INSTALL.md and the docs/ files.
